purpose: Synthesize already-persisted model-family evidence into a review dossier without fitting models, reusing row-level validation data, changing historical gates, or inventing a pooled promotion score.

review_logic.reason: No preregistered independent external portfolio has passed its registered XGBoost model-family support gate, while the original Spanish locked OOT did not support a global challenger switch and is now consumed retrospective validation.
reopen_requirements: A genuinely new independent external dataset or new independent period whose row-level outcomes have not been inspected in this project.
Protocol merged before row-level outcome access with source, split, features, models, metrics, gates, solver/tolerance and reproducibility rules fixed prospectively.
Any positive external-support result must satisfy its registered model-performance gates.
Any positive external-support result must satisfy the prospective two-independent-Actions execution and registered numerical reproducibility requirement inherited from v0.38-v0.42.
A separate authorised governance decision would still be required before any serving-bundle or customer-pricing change.

interpretation_boundaries: This synthesis is a project model-risk review dossier, not an insurer model-approval policy.
No source establishes transport to FIRST CENTRAL or the current UK motor market.
The datasets differ in geography, period, features and portfolio context; no pooled causal or meta-analytic effect is claimed.
Cross-sectional benchmark performance is development evidence and cannot override failed independent validation gates.
HOLD means evidence does not support promotion under the registered project contracts; it does not mean XGBoost is universally inferior to GLM.
